summary: Listed as a lookout in Glynn County, Georgia, with GFC number 849; no source found describes its history or whether it still stands.

evidence.supports: Tower list: Brunswick in Glynn County, coordinates 31.19222,-81.50529, GFC number 849
The page's More info list describes the tower list as covering lat/lon, elevation and GFC number
evidence.quote: GA tower list lat/lon, elevation, GFC number

evidence.supports: The same page links to the Georgia Forestry Commission
Page carries a Google map revision stamp dated 22 March 2016
Forest Lookouts Georgia index names Brunswick, Glynn County, and gives nothing more
Wikipedia: Brunswick is a city in and the county seat of Glynn County
evidence.quote: city in and the county seat of Glynn County

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Only two lists name this lookout (the tnlandforms Georgia tower list and the Forest Lookouts Georgia index). No register, dated, descriptive or newspaper source was found, so build date, design, staffing, status and access are unknown. The story is about 110 words of body text with no history beyond the lists; hold for archival work (Georgia Forestry Commission records, Glynn County newspapers) before extending. Not reached: brunswickga.org fire department history (403), gfc.state.ga.us history page (timed out). Two web searches gave nothing tower-specific. The list's elevation column (12) has no stated unit and is not used. Wikipedia is cited only for the city and its county seat status. Nothing was attempted on site access.
